name: salin
description: Turn MKV and other video containers into MP4 or MP3 — copying the streams when it can
author: Juan Miguel Luna

scripts.app: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.app:win: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --win --config electron-builder.yml
